    1. apply(VirtualControllerManager, String)

Interface Command

All Superinterfaces:
Message, Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
GameCommand, HeartbeatCommand, LobbyCommand
All Known Implementing Classes:
CreateLobbyCommand, JoinLobbyCommand, LeaveLobbyCommand, MoveTotemCommand, PingCommand, PongCommand, ReconnectCommand, ResolveActionsCommand, SelectTotemCommand, SetUsernameCommand
public sealed interface Command extends Message permits GameCommand, LobbyCommand, ReconnectCommand, HeartbeatCommand
Sealed interface for all client-to-server commands. Each concrete record carries its payload as record components and implements apply(VirtualControllerManager, String) to dispatch itself to the correct VirtualControllerManager method, eliminating switch logic in the transport handlers.

Subtypes are split into:

  • LobbyCommand — pre-game actions
  • GameCommand — in-game actions
  • ReconnectCommand — reconnection after disconnection
  • HeartbeatCommand — liveness probes (PingCommand, PongCommand), handled at the transport layer

  • Method Details

    • apply

      void apply(VirtualControllerManager manager, String clientId)
      Applies this command to the given VirtualControllerManager. Implements the Inversion of Control pattern: each command knows which manager method to invoke, keeping SocketClientHandler free of any switch logic.

      Heartbeat subtypes (PingCommand, PongCommand) are intercepted before this method is called; invoking apply on them throws UnsupportedOperationException.

      Parameters:
      manager - the controller manager to dispatch to
      clientId - the identifier of the client that sent this command
